title: Minichunk
description: This is an plugin for pre generate world
body:
#  Minichunk

MiniChunk is a lightweight, high-performance world pre-generation plugin designed to efficiently generate Minecraft chunks with minimal performance impact. Built as a fast and optimized alternative, MiniChunk focuses on stability, speed, and simplicity.

✨ Features
⚡ Fast and optimized chunk pre-generation

🧠 Smart resource usage to reduce lag

📊 Real-time progress tracking

🛠️ Simple and clean command system

🔄 Safe generation without freezing the server

💾 Memory-efficient processing

📈 Designed for large world borders and survival servers

🚀 Why MiniChunk?
Generating large areas of your world can cause lag spikes and TPS drops. MiniChunk solves this by:

Running generation tasks in a controlled way

Preventing server overload

Giving you better control over chunk processing

Maintaining smooth gameplay during generation

Perfect for:

Survival servers

SMP worlds

Public servers preparing maps

Servers with world borders 

Any server

🎯 Performance Focused
MiniChunk is built with performance as the top priority. It minimizes CPU spikes, reduces unnecessary memory usage, and ensures chunk generation runs smoothly in the background.

📦 Commands

/minichunk radius [shape(square, circle)] [chunks value, whole] - select shape and value

/minichunk start  – Start pre-generation

/minichunk stop – Stop generation

/minichunk status – Check progress

/minichunk world[world name] - select world

/minichunk pause - pause an generation

/minichunk resume - resume an paused generation

🔧 Compatibility
Modern Minecraft server versions

Works with Paper / Spigot / Bukkit based servers

Designed to be lightweight and stable
